stories.title: Australia’s CPI surprise keeps RBA on alert, but weak growth signals argue for patience
stories.summaryEn: AUSTRALIA: Australia's October CPI rose to 4.9% year-on-year, driven by higher transport and electricity prices, with broader pass-through to core inflation. Despite the upside inflation surprise, falling oil prices and a weakening labour market should allow the Reserve Bank to keep rates unchanged as growth slows into 2027

stories.title: The US tariff wall keeps changing, but it isn’t coming down
stories.summaryEn: TRADE: The US is preparing another round of tariffs, this time targeting structural overcapacity across 16 trading partners. It is another reminder that while the legal justification for tariffs keeps changing, US protectionism is becoming increasingly difficult to unwind

stories.title: Strong growth and elevated inflation signal more Fed tightening
stories.summaryEn: NORTH AMERICA: Solid growth, decent jobs and elevated inflation all point to the need for further policy tightening from the Federal Reserve. Nonetheless, the plunge in commodity prices and the weak wage growth environment suggest the Fed doesn't need to move aggressively

stories.title: Rates Spark: No risk appetite for Thanksgiving dinner
stories.summaryEn: Despite another hot US inflation reading, rates are under downward pressure amid fragile risk sentiment. Growing concerns about growth could push down the belly of the euro curve as they did in 2008 and 2023. Meanwhile, the ECB will likely wait until 2027 to evaluate minimum reserve requirements

stories.title: German consumers still don’t share companies’ optimism
stories.summaryEn: EUROPE: While leading business sentiment indicators like the Ifo index and the PMI point to a continuation of the cyclical rebound of the German economy, consumers' wallets remain closed

stories.title: FX Daily: Korean won stands out in a harsh EM environment
stories.summaryEn: It looks like the sell-off in risk assets has run its course for now, with investors starting to find value in equities, commodities and some FX pairs. How long this calm lasts is unknown, since it looks like the Fed will have to push ahead with tightening. To withstand dollar strength, currencies will need a good story. The Korean won has one

stories.title: The Commodities Feed: Oil extends rally as copper rebounds
stories.summaryEn: Oil prices continued to climb as escalating tensions in the Middle East kept supply risks in focus, while copper bounced after Wednesday’s sharp sell-off. Gold remained close to a 15-month low as expectations for higher-for-longer US rates continued to weigh on precious metals

stories.title: How Spain’s parties plan to raise incomes as low earners gain ground
stories.summaryEn: EUROPE: Spain's monthly pay rose faster at the bottom than across much of the middle, though the largest gains were concentrated near the top. The political parties differ on how to raise incomes. Some favour a higher minimum wage and shorter working hours; others emphasise tax cuts and hiring incentives, or propose deregulation and tighter access to benefits

stories.title: Minutes of ECB’s October meeting confirm tightening bias
stories.summaryEn: The minutes of the ECB's October meeting confirm a clear tightening bias and suggest a rate hike at the December meeting is almost a done deal

stories.title: Hungary’s labour market tightens again, but risks are building
stories.summaryEn: HUNGARY: Hungary’s labour market appears to have shaken off its summer weakness. But still-elevated wage pressures, worsening firing intentions and persistent geopolitical uncertainty keep us cautious about the outlook

stories.title: Stock futures tick higher as Wall Street gets set to wrap up a volatile holiday week: Live updates
stories.summaryEn: Investors are wrapping up a turbulent trading week that was shortened due to the Thanksgiving holiday.

stories.summaryEn: Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said "The incident is suspicious and looks like a precooked recipe for war."

stories.title: China industrial profits growth surges to a 5-month high of 20.1% in October
stories.summaryEn: China's economy has been running at two speeds, with AI-related manufacturing and exports powering growth while household consumption has been lagging.

stories.title: Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos set to lead European Central Bank

stories.title: What is ‘texture-maxxing’? The food trend putting crunch on the menu
stories.summaryEn: Texture-maxxing is the latest food trend taking social media by storm as consumers, driven by aesthetics and taste, are now looking for a sensory experience too.

stories.title: U.S. tariff-hike threats pile pressure on partners to sign trade deals

stories.summaryEn: Swiss regulator FINMA said UBS can execute its preferred crisis-resolution strategy, even as the bank faces a separate parliamentary fight over tougher capital requirements.

stories.summaryEn: Proposed tariffs of 18% on Bangladesh, Cambodia, Thailand, and 20% on China and Vietnam, subject to their respective trade deals, offer India a competitive advantage.
